description.value:
You launch a superheated plasma projectile from your omni-tool that burns through armor and sets targets ablaze.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. It must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-incinerate] save. Incinerate ignores up to 5 points of fire resistance.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d4[persistent,fire]] damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Armor Frames hit by Incinerate take 1.5× damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d4[persistent,fire]].

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

When the target rolls the save above, this power's damage and persistent fire are applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
